name: com.qcat.fastnoise-lite
description: FastNoiseLite 1.1.1 procedural noise generation for Unity. A single-file, dependency-free C# port of Auburn's FastNoiseLite (https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoiseLite) covering OpenSimplex2, OpenSimplex2S, Cellular, Perlin, Value and Value Cubic noise, fractal layering and domain warping. Ships with an optional "Noise Examples" sample containing 12 interactive scenes.

author.name: Jordan Peck (upstream FastNoiseLite author) / Max Cholushkin (Unity package & samples)

samples.description: 12 interactive examples covering noise generation, fractals, domain warping, terrain, islands, resources, and benchmarking.
